title.consent: Your keys will not be protected by the system

status.updating: Local services are stopped. Verifying the downloaded app and restarting…
status.stopping: Finishing work and stopping owned services…

startup.actionFailed: The action could not finish. Open Logs, or quit and reopen Animama after fixing the problem.
startup.genericError: Startup could not finish. Open Logs for details, fix the problem, and retry. Your local data has been preserved.

secureStorage.macos: macOS secure storage is unavailable. Unlock your login keychain and allow Animama to use it, then quit and reopen Animama.
secureStorage.windows: Windows protected storage is unavailable for this account. Sign in to Windows with your own account, not a temporary profile, and retry.
secureStorage.linux: The secret store that protects your keys is locked or not running. Unlock or start it (for example GNOME Keyring, KeePassXC or KWallet), then quit and reopen Animama. Your data has not changed.

freshProfile.macos: quit Animama and run pnpm desktop:mac:reset to archive this profile and start fresh
freshProfile.windows: quit Animama and rename %LOCALAPPDATA%\Animama (for example to Animama.backup) to keep this profile and start fresh
freshProfile.linux: quit Animama and rename the Animama data folder (~/.local/share/Animama, for example to Animama.backup) to keep this profile and start fresh

sandbox.title: Animama cannot start without its sandbox
sandbox.message: Animama was started with Chromium's sandbox turned off (--no-sandbox). This usually means the system blocks unprivileged user namespaces, as Ubuntu 23.10 and later do by default, and the AppImage launcher turned the sandbox off in response. Animama does not run web content unsandboxed. Allow user namespaces for Animama with an AppArmor profile, or set kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0, then start Animama again. Your data has not changed.

advice.gateway_port_in_use: The saved application port is occupied. Close the other application using it and retry. Your data has not changed.
advice.data_path_too_long: Your Windows profile folder path is too long for Animama data. Use a Windows account whose profile path is shorter, then reopen Animama.
advice.administrator_launch_unsupported: Animama cannot run its private database with administrator rights. Quit, then open Animama normally instead of with Run as administrator. Your data has not changed.
advice.vault_unreadable: Protected settings could not be unlocked. Restore the matching vault and database backup; do not delete either to reset this error.
advice.vault_missing_for_database: This database is missing its matching vault. Restore both from your backup.
advice.previous_runtime_running: A process from an earlier launch is still running. Wait a few seconds and retry. If this continues, quit that Animama instance or restart your computer.
advice.unsupported_postgresql_major: This database needs a supported upgrade. Your existing data has been preserved.
advice.runtime_manifest_invalid: The runtime is missing or damaged. Reinstall a complete Animama build; your user data is separate.
advice.runtime_file_invalid: An installed runtime file is missing or damaged. Reinstall Animama without deleting your data.
advice.unsupported_runtime_platform: This Animama build needs macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon, Windows 10 version 1903 or later on x64, or Linux on x64 no older than the system it was built on. Your data has not changed.
advice.runtime_busy: Animama is still finishing local work. The previous configuration is preserved; wait for recovery and retry the change.
advice.runtime_quiesce_failed: Local work could not be stopped safely. The previous configuration is preserved. Open Logs or restart Animama before retrying.
advice.migration_failed: The database upgrade failed. The original snapshot is preserved below. Open Logs, fix the cause, and retry this version. Do not reset, downgrade, or restore automatically: that could discard newer data.
advice.pre_migration_backup_failed: The database snapshot could not be verified. No migration was started. Check disk space and Logs before retrying.
advice.migration_recovery_required: A previous database upgrade needs attention. Keep its snapshot and the current database. Open Logs and finish that upgrade before trying a different version.
advice.update_install_timeout: The installer did not finish in time. Services remain stopped for safety. Quit and reopen Animama, or reinstall the signed version. Do not reset your data.
advice.owned_services_stop_failed: Some Animama services could not stop. Quit again or restart your computer before updating. Your data is preserved.
advice.database_schema_mismatch: Your local database does not match the structure this version of Animama expects, so startup stopped before using it. Your local data is preserved, and retrying will not change this. For a development build, {{freshProfile}}. Otherwise, reopen the Animama version that created this data.
advice.content_startup_failed: Animama could not reconcile its content library, so startup stopped instead of running incomplete. Your local data is preserved. Open Logs for details, then retry. If a development build keeps failing here, {{freshProfile}}.
advice.unprotected_storage_consent_required: Animama found no secret store on this system. If you continue, your provider keys and the database password are saved without system protection: any program running under this account can read them. To protect them instead, quit, start a secret store such as GNOME Keyring, KeePassXC or KWallet, and reopen Animama. You are asked this once.
